title: Lower Bound
statement: Find the first index with value at least target, or n. The array is nondecreasing. Print only the required integer and handle targets outside the array range.
input_format: n target followed by n sorted integers.
brute_force_python: x=list(map(int,open(0).read().split()));n,t=x[:2];a=x[2:];print(next((i for i,v in enumerate(a) if v>=t),n))

title: Upper Bound
statement: Find the first index with value greater than target, or n. The array is nondecreasing. Print only the required integer and handle targets outside the array range.
input_format: n target followed by n sorted integers.
brute_force_python: x=list(map(int,open(0).read().split()));n,t=x[:2];a=x[2:];print(next((i for i,v in enumerate(a) if v>t),n))

title: First Occurrence
statement: Print the first index of target in a sorted array, or -1. The array is nondecreasing. Print only the required integer and handle targets outside the array range.
input_format: n target followed by n sorted integers.
reference_python:
import bisect
x=list(map(int,open(0).read().split()));n,t=x[:2];a=x[2:];i=bisect.bisect_left(a,t);print(i if i<n and a[i]==t else -1)
brute_force_python: x=list(map(int,open(0).read().split()));n,t=x[:2];a=x[2:];print(next((i for i,v in enumerate(a) if v==t),-1))

title: Last Occurrence
statement: Print the last index of target in a sorted array, or -1. The array is nondecreasing. Print only the required integer and handle targets outside the array range.
input_format: n target followed by n sorted integers.
reference_python:
import bisect
x=list(map(int,open(0).read().split()));n,t=x[:2];a=x[2:];i=bisect.bisect_right(a,t)-1;print(i if i>=0 and a[i]==t else -1)
brute_force_python: x=list(map(int,open(0).read().split()));n,t=x[:2];a=x[2:];print(max((i for i,v in enumerate(a) if v==t),default=-1))

title: Count Occurrences
statement: Count how many times target appears in a sorted array. The array is nondecreasing. Print only the required integer and handle targets outside the array range.
input_format: n target followed by n sorted integers.
